"If youre looking for kind, supportive creators of all experience levels who teach what they know, share opportunities, and ALSO prioritize work/life balance and personal well-being, organizing your life so you take time to recharge and do work you enjoy, theyre wonderful. /end"

"On that note, I want to thank the @USER/StorytellingCol and Scribemind communities especially. I wont name names because they dont need to be dragged into a possible Twitter hot mess, haha, but they know who they are. Theyve taught me so much and tried to keep me accountable. 18/x"

"Thats social media and community at its best. You may feel lonely sometimes, but you are seen and loved, sometimes by total strangers or people you only know online. Lets give each other grace, support and celebrate each others successes, and pay it forward when we can. 17/x"

"And if thats not you, its ok to be quiet too. I certainly have been so no judgment here. But realizing its ok to reach out, speak out, and know there are others who understand what youre going through, thats really freeing and reassuring. 16/x"

"And now I know, I realize I can change things. Theres no magic cure, and improvement is a process, but you need to know to start the journey. The thing I love about the ttrpg community is that so many folks are open about both their highs and lows, are supportive, advocate 15/x"

"And it never occurred to me I had anxiety instead of just some weird inflammatory chest pain no doctor could diagnose. I didnt realize that waking up multiple times every night with a racing heart, sometimes kicking and screaming, wasnt just being "high-strung." 14/x"

"I did play a lot of video games 😋  Gosh, tangent but growing up Chinese American is totally making a deal with your parents to earn a minute of Nintendo time for every minute you practice the piano (the ratio started as like 5 piano: 1 Nintendo but Mario deserved better) 12/x"

"Anyway, I guess the point is that we shouldnt be afraid to talk about our experiences and then ask for help if we realize somethings off. Id never have thought to ask a doctor about ADHD if I didnt see a post that said "You can have good grades and still have ADHD." 13/x"

"I am on medication for my conditions. Being willing to do that was a journey and I have my partner Theo to thank for that. I grew up in a household distrustful of Western medicine, thinking it would hurt your liver and affect your qi. 10/x"

"We place superhuman expectations on ourselves when we are human and we dismiss our accomplishments to focus on our failures. Then we hide it all and put on our best faces. And that isnt healthy and it isnt sustainable. 9/x"

"To be clear my parents are wonderful and smart and understand things like infections and chemical imbalances benefit from a Western approach. Theyre vaccinated. But there was always shame, like your immune system failed because you played video games instead of exercising. 11/x"

"You can desperately want something, try as hard as you can, but your body or your circumstances fail you. And when that happens you try to take care of yourself and if "getting better" isnt in the cards, you cope, you adjust your scope, and you can still thrive. 8/x"

"I used to be sympathetic to folks who talked about not having the spoons to do something, but I realize now I never really *understood* it fully. At a subconscious level I bought into US culture that drive and achievement is worth. But I get it now. 7/x"

"And depression. Its a weird beast and a more recent thing, but just suddenly losing interest in things you used to love is weird. Not having energy to do what you want is weird. It feels like youve lost a part of yourself and you dont know how to begin to find it. 6/x"

"Ive always had trouble paying attention in class and at meetings. Id daydream, write stories, start taking notes and then just stop because I couldnt focus. Id cram late at night and parrot phrases in conversations to compensate. I thought I was lazy and a moral failure. 5/x"

"You can be all those things, highly productive, and still struggle. Your struggles are valid. Underneath that, my anxiety manifested as chest pain almost every day. I had probably 2 pain-free days a month, and about a week every 2 months where it hurt so much I couldnt sleep.4/x"

"Ive recently, in my 30s, been diagnosed with anxiety of the panic disorder type, depression, and adhd. Why so late? I didnt fit the "stereotypes." I was a straight A student, engineering degree summa cum laude, flying colors on physicals, performed well at my job. 3/x"

"And it makes Elué a fascinating power player in the story. She's in the unique position of knowing her god owes her a personal debt. As unrest grows in Mystra's domain over the damage wrought by the Spellplague, Mystra may need Elué to protect her from her own worshipers."

"It also adds layers to Mystra's characterization, showing the difficult choices she makes as a god, putting those she loves in no-win situations for the greater good. Mystra KNOWS she ruined Elué and Dornal's lives, and that guilt and how she navigates it is an intriguing story."

"Second, her exposure to Mystra's magic gives her limited prophetic abilities. Events unfolded the way they did because she knew the alternatives were worse. Is that a hokey explanation? Yes, but it makes sense and gives her much-needed motivation for sacrificing her entire life."

"My approach was to stick with the facts of canon as much as possible but make Elué a player in her own story. First, I made her equivalent to Mystra's other Chosen, giving her a continuous say in her relationship with Mystra rather than allowing Mystra to possess her for years."

"The problems with Elué's depiction are numerous: she's defined by her motherhood and her fate never addressed beyond that; she's given no agency and portrayed as deceitful; any outrage the narrative summons is on behalf of her husband and it goes to absurd lengths to babysit him."

"When I set out to write a Mystra-centric adventure, the first question was which other characters from her life should be involved. The parents of the Seven Sisters made sense, and while both suffered due to their involvement with Mystra, Elué's treatment in the lore stood out."
